//: EDITOR FEEDBACK ONLY. This file is not a build step and is not wired into
`npm test` or CI -- nothing in the repo reads it except your editor's
TypeScript language service. There is no TypeScript dependency, no .ts
file and no compile: `noEmit` is on and the code stays plain runnable
JavaScript.
Its purpose is to make the JSDoc typedefs in tybotRoute/types/index.js
actually do something: with `checkJs` on, the editor checks the annotated
call sites as you type. The codebase does NOT type-check clean today, and
it is not expected to -- treat the squiggles as a to-do list, never as a
gate. If you want the current count, run a tsc you already have against
this file with --noEmit; do not add TypeScript to package.json to do it.
Settings are deliberately lenient (strict off, no implicit-any errors):
the goal is signal on the shapes we have declared, not a wall of noise
from the ones we have not.
tybotRoute/test is excluded for the same reason: mocha's globals
(describe/it/before/after) have no type declarations here -- @types/mocha
is not installed and adding a dependency for an editor convenience is not
worth it -- so including the tests would bury the real findings under ~540
'Cannot find name describe' errors. Excluding them costs nothing at
runtime; it only means the editor does not type-check test files.
